title: It takes 6,090 bids to get one click
number: 53,289,330 bids → 12,237,087 impressions (23.0% win rate) → 8,751 clicks (0.072% CTR) → 391 post-click conversions
meaning: Most volume is lost in the auction, but the impressions nobody clicks are the paid loss. Improving CTR is the cheapest way to lower cost per click.

title: Campaign 3386: slot format 0 loses the most clicks
number: 356 fewer clicks than at the campaign's average CTR (0.056% vs 0.072%, on 2,176,840 impressions)
meaning: Lower the bid or exclude this segment in a test, and move the budget to segments that click above average.
